conviction_note: This is Freenome's first quarterly report as a public company (de-SPAC closed 2026-07-20). There is no option chain and no print history, so the scale is set from 73.8% 20-day realised volatility and the name's own +/-11% moves on recent single news days. The evidence is balanced and the bar is disputed, so p_up stays at 50. The findings sum to about -0.1 and the scaled number is 0; they agree.
bar: DISPUTED. Q3 2026 revenue consensus is $84.94M on TradingView (https://www.tradingview.com/symbols/NASDAQ-FRNM/) and $84.9M from 5 analysts on The Right Trader (https://therighttrader.com/earnings-calendar/frnm), against $107.98M with EPS +$0.41 on FXEmpire (https://www.fxempire.com/stocks/frnm/earnings). TradingView's EPS consensus is +$0.14. Either way the bar assumes most or all of the $100M Abbott FDA-approval milestone is booked as Q3 revenue, against a Q2 2026 base of $2.27M. The company gives no guidance. Every finding that depends on the bar is capped small. The -10% print_vs_bar assumes partial deferral of the milestone, the way the $75M upfront was partly deferred. It is a low-confidence read.
positioning_check: Short interest 4.48M shares, up from 3.40M the month before; 9.01% of a 49.78M float; days to cover 4.91 (stockanalysis.com statistics page, read 2026-11-10, settlement date not shown, https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/frnm/statistics/). Massive put it at 3.4M shares and 3.3 days at 2026-09-30. Short interest is rising but not crowded. There is no option market, so no skew. Spot is $10.30: 3.1% above the 52-week low, -18.5% over 20 days and -10.2% over 5 days, and $0.30 above the $10.00 PIPE price. Peer Guardant (GH) fell about 12% on 2026-11-05 and 5.5% on 2026-11-06 on a wider cash-burn guide, the likely read-across for the 5-day drop. Five to six analysts cover the name, all Buy/Outperform, average target about $18.

findings.finding: The going-concern doubt the sweep flagged in July 2026 belongs to the pre-merger SPAC shell's 10-Q (filed 2026-07-15; doubt tied to the mandatory liquidation date), not to the operating company. Freenome's own Q2 MD&A shows $102.0M of cash and short-term securities at 2026-06-30, plus $295.5M net de-SPAC/PIPE proceeds and the $100M FDA milestone, and says these fund operations 'through 2028'. Q3 cash should land near $400M+ (6-month operating burn $97.1M, about $48.6M a quarter), against a $1.1B market cap.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print. The stock fell from $14.09 (2026-08-26) to $10.30 with no financing event, so dilution fear is not visibly what is pricing it.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the runway is in the August 8-K/A. Aggregators (equibles, biopharmawatch's '$0M liquidity, Medium dilution-risk' snapshot) still show the SPAC-era going-concern and zero liquidity, so a screen-driven holder could be reading stale distress. If the market had fully priced $400M+ cash on a $1.1B cap, the stock would not sit at the $10 PIPE price with short interest rising. The positive is small because the institutions that set the price can read the 8-K/A.
findings.independence: Same document as the revenue-recognition finding below, read for a different line. The going-concern origin is from equibles/Quartr Q1 2026 SPAC summaries (https://quartr.com/events/freenome-inc-frnm-q1-2026_Ftkl9962), which tie the doubt to the business-combination deadline.

findings.finding: Revenue-recognition risk on the bar: consensus ($85M-$108M) assumes the $100M FDA-approval milestone (triggered July 2026) is booked as Q3 revenue. Freenome treated the $75M upfront from the same agreement as partly deferred: about $27.9M recognized in Q4 2025, $3.7M in Q1 2026, $1.5M in Q2 2026, and deferred revenue up $14.8M in H1 2026. The MD&A does not say how the milestone is recognized. Partial deferral would print a headline revenue/EPS 'miss' with no economic change.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print as a public company. Small-cap diagnostics names usually look through milestone accounting, but a newly listed, thinly read name with algorithmic headline coverage can react to the headline in the first session.
findings.why_not_priced: The two consensus sources disagree by $23M, a sign the street has not settled the accounting. If deferral were priced, the consensus would sit near $30-40M, not $85-108M. Quarterly revenue history is from stockanalysis (https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/frnm/financials/?p=quarterly). Capped small because the bar is disputed and the cash is real either way.
findings.independence: The consensus split is from TradingView/The Right Trader versus FXEmpire (URLs in bar). The quarterly revenue pattern is from stockanalysis, which matches the 8-K/A's Q2 and 6-month figures.

findings.finding: The v2 milestone ($100M on first-line FDA approval of the next-gen test) is contingent on benchmarks 'such as >=19% APL sensitivity and >=83% overall CRC sensitivity', with reduced payments below them. The v2 data of 2026-10-11/12 showed 18.2% APL and 80.4% CRC, below both. The call may quantify the reduced payment or the v2 PMA timeline.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock fell 11% on 2026-10-13 on the v2 data (tikr). That is the only reaction to the v2/milestone line.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced by the -11% in October. What is not priced is the dollar size of the reduced milestone, which no source quantifies. If the market knew it was, say, $50M, the October drop would have been followed by estimate cuts, and the tikr piece says analysts had no reason to cut.
findings.independence: v2 numbers from https://www.tikr.com/blog/freenome-sinks-11-despite-clinically-meaningful-gains-for-next-gen-colon-cancer-blood-test (2026-10-13). The benchmarks are from Exact's own 8-K exhibit.

findings.finding: Guardant's Q3 2026 (reported 2026-11-05, after Freenome last spoke) shows the blood-based CRC category expanding fast: 83,000 Shield tests (+246%), screening revenue $67.6M (+180%), ASP above $800, commercial coverage over 80% of eligible lives, and a raised full-year Shield guide of 285-290k tests. GH still fell about 12% then 5.5% on a wider cash-burn guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None for FRNM. FRNM's -10% over 5 days coincides with GH's post-print drop, so the peer's reaction transmitted on cash burn, not on category demand.
findings.why_not_priced: FRNM sold off with GH on a burn issue specific to GH (oncology pricing, FCF guide), while the category data were positive for a royalty holder. If the category read were priced, FRNM would not have moved down with GH. It is a proxy: Freenome's royalty is 0-10% scaled to profitability, so near-term dollars are small.

findings.finding: Abbott launched SimpleScreen CRC only in late September 2026 and positions it as an option for people who decline guideline-recommended screening, sold beside its own Cologuard Plus. An analyst expects Abbott to prioritize Cologuard. Abbott disclosed no SimpleScreen numbers in its Q3 release (2026-10-21). Q3 royalty or volume contribution is effectively nil, and the first royalty data will be thin.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None. The launch itself (2026-09-30) produced no reported stock move.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: Abbott's stool-first positioning is known. What is open is whether management gives early order or uptake numbers on the call. Thin or absent numbers against $18 targets that assume a ramp to $208M revenue by 2028 would be a mild negative.
findings.independence: Analyst view that Abbott prioritizes Cologuard: https://www.fiercebiotech.com/medtech/fda-signs-freenomes-bowel-cancer-screener-abbott-preps-sell-blood-test-us. Abbott Q3: https://www.ariva.de/news/abbott-reports-third-quarter-2026-results-and-reaffirms-6438426

findings.finding: On 2026-10-20 Freenome launched SimpleScreen Lung, its own LDT (85% sensitivity at 50% specificity, NPV 99.8%), plus a single-draw lung+CRC bundle that it sells itself. This is the first revenue channel Freenome controls, and the Q3 call is the first chance for early demand, pricing or reimbursement commentary.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock rose about 11% on the launch day (tikr, 'Freenome Soars 11%'), then gave it back: $12.57 on 2026-10-19 versus $10.30 now.
findings.why_not_priced: The launch was priced and then unpriced: the full +11% retraced. Any early-volume number is new because the product is three weeks old. 50% specificity makes it a triage test with uncertain reimbursement, which is why it is sized small.

findings.finding: Positioning: spot $10.30 sits 3% above the 52-week low and $0.30 above the $10.00 PIPE price, after -18.5% over 20 days. Short interest rose about 32% month on month to 4.48M shares (9% of float, 4.9 days to cover). All 5-6 covering analysts are Buy with an average target near $18. A first print with $400M+ of cash and no financing need gives shorts no new negative.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None as a print. The stock's single-day news moves have been +/-11% both ways.
findings.why_not_priced: Rising short interest into a first print, near the PIPE price, is an asymmetric setup only if the print is clean. If the market had already priced a clean print, short interest would be falling into the date. Not crowded (9%), so sized small.

outside_window.finding: Six-month lock-up on the sponsor, the former Freenome holders and the PIPE investors runs from the 2026-07-20 close, so it expires about 2027-01-20. 75.2M shares are already registered for resale (424B3 of 2026-08-27).
$500M milestone tied to a first-line USPSTF A/B rating or payer coverage, with a reduced payment for second-line. No USPSTF action is dated inside the window.

Abbott Q3 2026 call: no disclosed SimpleScreen volume or ASP found in summaries
SimpleScreen CRC Medicare payment rate or ADLT status: no CMS fee or ADLT listing found
News from 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-10 specific to Freenome: none found beyond the GH read-across

baseline_tension: The baseline has no skew and no history. The -18.5% 20-day run-up and the spot near the 52-week low and the PIPE price lean mildly against further downside. The revenue-recognition risk and the reduced v2 milestone lean negative, so the net is about zero.
lessons_applied: Rule 6 (bar unsourced or disputed): the two consensus sources disagree ($85M vs $108M), so the revenue-recognition finding was capped from -1.0 to -0.8.
Rule 4 (financing is a question): the cash funds operations through 2028 and is already in a public 8-K/A, so the financing positive was cut from +0.5 to +0.3 as mostly priced.
Rule 7: short interest checked at 9% of float, not crowded, so the negatives were left standing.
Rule 5: the Guardant read-across kept small as a proxy (+0.3). The two changes offset, so the sum stays -0.1 and p_up stays 50.
